tips.text: Use Rake, Noxian Diplomacy, then an attack on one champion. Three Wound stacks let your next attack make them bleed for heavy damage.
Cast Noxian Diplomacy when you are already in melee range. It then critically strikes for more damage.
Vault over a wall with Assassin's Path to get behind a target or to leave a fight. You can't cross the same wall again for a long time.
Rake hits everything in a cone on the way out and again on the way back. Stand so enemies are in the cone for both hits, and they will be slowed.
Save Shadow Assault to escape or to start a fight. Invisibility and extra Move Speed let you walk away or close in on a target.
Pick off a target that is low on health with Noxian Diplomacy. A kill heals you and cuts its cooldown, so you can chain into the next target.
Choose your target before the fight and put all your abilities on them. Splitting damage between several enemies leaves you without a kill.
Hit large monsters with your abilities to build Wound stacks on them, then finish with an attack for extra damage.

combos.name: Wall hop into Q
combos.when: Closing on a target who is standing near a wall, or cutting off one who is running.
combos.text: Vault the wall to get in close, then use the melee-range version of the leap so it crits. Close-range casting is what makes the leap hit harder.

combos.name: Ult during the leap
combos.when: Going in on a target when you want the invisibility and the blade damage during your dash.
combos.text: The wiki notes that Shadow Assault can be cast while Noxian Diplomacy is dashing. Cast it mid-leap so you don't waste time before the attack.

tips.text: Hit the enemy with Rake, Noxian Diplomacy or Shadow Assault, three times in a row, then auto attack. Blade's End then makes them bleed for heavy damage.
Cast Noxian Diplomacy when you are already next to the enemy; up close it hits much harder as a critical strike.
Use Assassin's Path to vault a wall and land behind the enemy, then jump on them with Noxian Diplomacy.
Use Noxian Diplomacy on a low-health minion or enemy to heal and get part of its cooldown back.
Throw Rake so it hits several enemies on the way out and again on the way back; the return leaves them slowed.
Pick one target before the fight and put all your abilities on them. Splitting damage across many enemies leaves you weak.
Save Shadow Assault as your escape, since it makes you invisible and fast. Without it you are easy to catch.
Each wall can only be vaulted with Assassin's Path once in a long while, so pick which walls to use when roaming or fleeing.

combos.name: Wall hop
combos.when: When roaming, chasing or escaping around mid lane walls.
combos.text: Vault over the thin walls near mid lane to roam or cut off a target. Each wall has its own cooldown, so you can't hop the same one again straight away.

combos.name: Shadow Assault into Q
combos.when: When you want to burst an enemy after a quiet approach.
combos.text: Cast the ultimate to go invisible, then leap onto the target with Q. This breaks stealth and sends the blades back to the target, not to you.

combos.name: Melee Q crit
combos.when: When you can get next to an enemy champion in a trade or kill.
combos.text: Vault past the enemy, then use Q at melee range to get the critical version. It lands a bigger hit and makes the next basic attack reach further.

tips.text: Look for Aatrox when Infernal Chains is on cooldown; without it he struggles to pin you down or drag you back.
Use Rake and Noxian Diplomacy together on Aatrox so Blade's End is ready, then hit him with a basic attack to make him bleed.
Slip away with Shadow Assault when Aatrox has landed his big hits. He cannot follow what he cannot see.
Do not fight Aatrox once he uses World Ender. Back off and wait out his extra damage, healing and speed.
Step sideways out of The Darkin Blade; its edge knocks you up, so do not stand at its tip.
Hit Ambessa with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy, then a basic attack, so Blade's End has its three stacks and she bleeds.
Don't jump on Ambessa while Repudiation's shield is up. Wait for it to end, then go in.
Use Rake on Ambessa as she closes in. It slows her, so she has a harder time diving you.
Keep Shadow Assault ready when you fight Ambessa. Its invisibility and speed let you escape when Public Execution is on cooldown.
Keep your distance from Amumu so Bandage Toss misses; if he lands it, he can stun you and your team can kill you.
Fight Amumu with Noxian Diplomacy and Rake only when his Tantrum is down; Tantrum reduces your physical damage.
Do not dive into a group when Curse of the Sad Mummy is ready; a stun there loses you the fight.
Look for easier targets than Amumu, since he is tanky and punishes a fight. Use Shadow Assault to escape if he catches you.
Hit Bel'Veth with Rake and then a basic attack; two spells plus the attack consume Wound stacks for big bleed damage while she is still weak early.
Jump in with Noxian Diplomacy when Bel'Veth uses Void Surge on a camp or wastes it; she has fewer ways to get out afterward.
Do not stand beside Bel'Veth when she has Royal Maelstrom ready; it cuts the damage she takes. Wait for it to end, then burst her.
Use Assassin's Path over walls to get behind Bel'Veth, so Above and Below and her dashes have a harder time catching you.
Fight her early; the longer the game goes, the more attack speed she stacks from takedowns, so deny her kills and big camps.
Dodge Brand's Sear. Without a first hit he cannot stun you, so his combo never gets going.
Jump on Brand with Noxian Diplomacy once his key spells are on cooldown; he has little to stop you then.
Use Shadow Assault to slip away when Brand has you ablaze and is about to stun you or fire Pyroclasm.
Walk out of Pillar of Flame as soon as you see it start; the delay gives you time to step away.
Hold Rake for when Briar leaps in; the slow from the returning blades helps you walk away from her fast, healing attacks.
Fight Briar when Head Rush is down; without her stun she is much easier to burst and to leave.
Burst Briar quickly with Noxian Diplomacy and Rake; the longer a fight lasts, the more her bleed heals her.
Keep Shadow Assault to get away if Briar locks onto you with Certain Death; it also makes you invisible.
Pick fights away from Darius. Open with Rake, then jump in with Noxian Diplomacy and finish before he can pull you with Apprehend.
Hit Darius with all three Wound stacks, then attack him so he bleeds. Use Rake and Noxian Diplomacy first.
Use Shadow Assault to get out when Darius lands his pull. Without it you are easy for him to catch.
Do not stay in a long brawl. Darius gets stronger the longer a fight lasts, so burst him and leave.
Use Assassin's Path to jump over walls and escape when Darius's pull is on cooldown or you are slowed.
Dodge Crescent Strike when you can; if Diana lands it, she can Lunar Rush onto you at once. Step out of its arc rather than running straight away.
Hold Shadow Assault until Diana has used Lunar Rush; with her dash down she cannot easily chase you or follow your escape.
Wait out Pale Cascade before you commit; her orbs hurt you on contact and the shield soaks your burst.
Use Rake on Diana as she dashes in; it leaves her slowed when the blades return.
Stay out of Moonfall range in a fight. If it pulls you in, you cannot dash away in time.
Dodge the Infected Bonesaw line when Mundo throws it; it slows you and hurts more the healthier you are.
Do not trade into Heart Zapper for long. Mundo heals back what you deal if he recasts it on you.
Kill Mundo fast with burst after he uses Maximum Dosage; otherwise he heals through your damage.
Use Shadow Assault to leave when Mundo gets close; his Infected Bonesaw slows you and makes you easy to catch.
Roam and gank other lanes rather than fighting Mundo head on. He is slow to chase down a Talon who vaults walls with Assassin's Path.
Hit Ekko with Rake, Noxian Diplomacy and Shadow Assault in one burst, then attack him so Blade's End finishes the job.
Fight when Chronobreak is down. Ekko can rewind out of your burst and heal if it is ready.
Ekko's Parallel Convergence is a stun zone that takes time to arm. Leave it with Assassin's Path or stay outside the circle.
Use Shadow Assault to slip away when Ekko has his Timewinder or Phase Dive ready to chase you.
Keep Assassin's Path ready for when Evelynn charms you. Vault a wall to get out before her burst lands.
Watch for the arrow that points to Evelynn once her mark on you has formed. Walk away or toward your team.
Shadow Assault is your escape when Evelynn jumps on you, and your best way to chase her. Use it to dodge her before she comes out of stealth.
Fight Evelynn when her Demon Shade is broken. Hit her with Rake and then Noxian Diplomacy to burst her.
Do not jump onto Fiddlesticks while he is hidden or standing still as a scarecrow; he can fear you with his next ability.
Dodge Reap or fight outside its center; being silenced stops Noxian Diplomacy and your escape.
Hit Fiddlesticks with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy and your basic attacks to burst him before Bountiful Harvest heals him.
Hit Fiddlesticks while he channels Bountiful Harvest or Crowstorm to deal damage, and use Shadow Assault to slip away from Crowstorm.
Fight Graves when Quickdraw is on cooldown; without that dash he has little to escape your burst with.
Jump on Graves with Noxian Diplomacy, then use Rake and attack to finish the Wound stacks. Focus him instead of splitting your damage.
Do not walk into Smoke Screen. Wait for it to fade or go around it, because you are slowed and cannot see out of it.
Use Shadow Assault to close the gap when Graves backs away, and to escape if his burst lands.
Keep Rake aimed so Graves is in the cone when you throw it. The slow on its return helps you stay on him.
Hold Rake and Noxian Diplomacy until Gwen's Hallowed Mist is used; she can't be targeted from outside it while it lasts.
Hit Gwen with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy, then an attack to finish building Wound before she can set up her attacks.
Jump her first. She needs a few attacks to build her damage, so strike before she has stacks.
Use Shadow Assault to escape or to chase when she is out of Hallowed Mist.
Use Assassin's Path to get behind her and set up a close-range Noxian Diplomacy.
Hit Hecarim with Rake and Noxian Diplomacy, then attack him to finish Blade's End. Stack all three Wound marks before you swing so the bleed lands.
Fight Hecarim early, before he has stacked up. He lacks durability, so burst him down fast.
Stay out of Spirit of Dread when you can. It heals Hecarim for damage he deals, so a long brawl inside it favors him.
Save Shadow Assault to escape his Onslaught of Shadows fear. Turn invisible and run once he commits.
Use Assassin's Path over a wall to break away when Hecarim charges you. His knock back does not carry you through terrain.
Ivern is a squishy support-style jungler, so pick him as your target and dive him with Noxian Diplomacy when Rootcaller is on cooldown.
Hold Assassin's Path to jump out if Ivern roots you with Rootcaller; dodge the vine by not walking in a straight line toward him.
Be careful fighting Ivern alone when Daisy is out. Wait for her to expire or kill Ivern first with a full burst.
Use Shadow Assault to get away if Daisy knocks you up or you get caught; its invisibility lets you leave the fight.
Rake's blades are blocked by projectiles; Daisy can block skillshots too, so aim at Ivern, not at her.
Check Ivern's brush before roaming through it; Brushmaker can hide an ambush and reveal your path.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard, or you get knocked up and burst down.
Jump into Jarvan with Noxian Diplomacy only when his Dragon Strike and Demacian Standard are down. Otherwise he can knock you up.
If Jarvan lands Cataclysm on you, vault out with Assassin's Path. It crosses the walls of terrain.
Hold Shadow Assault as your escape when Jarvan is near. Stay out of his reach before he reaches level 6.
Do not auto attack Jax while Counter Strike is up; wait until it ends and the stun has passed.
Hit Jax in short bursts with Rake and Noxian Diplomacy, then leave. A long fight lets Relentless Assault build his attack speed.
Use Rake to hold Jax back when he leaps in; the slow gives you room to get away.
Keep Shadow Assault ready to escape once Jax gets his armor and magic resist from Grandmaster-at-Arms.
Use Assassin's Path to get around Jax and out of reach; he can still follow with Leap Strike to a ward or unit.
Use Assassin's Path to vault a wall and come at Jayce from behind, then jump on him with Noxian Diplomacy before he can line up Shock Blast.
Hit Jayce with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy, then a basic attack. Three Wound stacks make Blade's End bleed him for heavy damage.
Hold Shadow Assault to escape or to finish a fight. Jayce has little to stop you once you turn invisible and run.
Stay out of Jayce's Shock Blast line when he is in cannon form. Fight him up close, where his cannon range does not help him.
Dive Karthus with Noxian Diplomacy and Rake together; he has no dash to escape and your burst kills him fast.
Do not hover over a dead Karthus; his Death Defied lets him keep casting, so step away from his corpse.
Use Shadow Assault to vanish and escape a Requiem channel, or to get to him; the beam of light shows he is channeling.
Cross a wall with Assassin's Path to reach Karthus from an unexpected side, and avoid walking through his Wall of Pain.
Hit Kayn with Rake when he fights in the open; the blades come back and leave him slowed, so you can follow with Noxian Diplomacy.
Pick your fight before Kayn gets his form. Early on he has no big bonus, so a quick burst from Talon wins more often.
Use Shadow Assault to escape if Kayn grabs you with Blade's Reach. Hold it for fights you can't win otherwise.
Stack three Wound with your spells, then attack to make Kayn bleed. Spread-out spells waste it.
Stay near your minions, allies or a turret when Kha'Zix is close. Taste Their Fear hits much harder on someone who is isolated.
Throw Rake when Kha'Zix steps in. It hits twice and leaves him slowed on the way back, so he can't chase you easily.
Wait until Kha'Zix has used Leap before you commit to him. Without it he has a hard time getting away from you.
Hit Kha'Zix with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy, then attack. Three stacks of Wound make Blade's End bleed him heavily.
Keep Shadow Assault ready to escape if Kha'Zix jumps on you. Its speed and invisibility let you get out of a bad fight.
Kindred is fragile, so pick her as your target and burst her with Noxian Diplomacy, Rake and a basic attack to finish with Blade's End.
Do not fight her inside Lamb's Respite; nobody inside can die. Wait out the zone or back off until it ends.
Use Assassin's Path over a wall to get behind her and cut off her escape.
If Kindred slows you with Mounting Dread, finish her fast or leave, since her third attack adds a pounce.
Use Shadow Assault to dive in or escape after your burst; the blades hit her on the way out and back.
Use Assassin's Path over walls to get behind Lee Sin or to leave when he has used Sonic Wave.
Stay away from Lee Sin when Dragon's Rage is ready; being kicked into your allies hurts them too.
Save Shadow Assault as your escape. Once Lee Sin has used his dash and kick, you can fight him.
Lee Sin is weaker to magic damage than physical. Fight him with Rake when he has just spent his shield.
Get behind Lillia with Assassin's Path, then jump in with Noxian Diplomacy up close so it hits as a critical strike.
Fight Lillia when Shadow Assault is ready; the invisibility lets you finish her or escape if her Swirlseed misses you.
Hit Lillia with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy, to build Wound stacks fast; one basic attack then makes her bleed.
Do not sit still when Lillia lands Watch Out! Eep!; walk out of the center to take less damage.
Once Lillia has been hit by her own spells, her Lilting Lullaby can put you to sleep, so strike first and kill her before it lands.
Rake slows Master Yi only if Highlander is off, so throw it before he activates it.
Hit Master Yi with Noxian Diplomacy and Rake early, before he heals back with Meditate.
Master Yi can't act during Alpha Strike, so step away or use Shadow Assault to avoid his dive.
Use Assassin's Path to vault walls and escape when Master Yi has Highlander running, since you can't outrun him.
Wait a moment after Wukong uses Warrior Trickster so you hit the real Wukong, not his clone.
Burst Wukong early with your abilities, then a basic attack; he gets much tougher as a fight drags on.
Do not dive into Wukong when Cyclone is ready; being knocked up ends your burst. Bait it out first.
Keep Shadow Assault ready to escape if Wukong lands Nimbus Strike on you.
Kill Naafiri's Packmates first only if you must; otherwise aim Rake so the blades hit her and the Packmates together on both passes.
Save Shadow Assault for when Naafiri commits to her fight. Turn invisible to escape or to reset onto her with Noxian Diplomacy.
Stack Wound with your abilities, then finish with one basic attack to make Naafiri bleed heavily before she can Eviscerate away.
Use Assassin's Path to jump a wall and cut off Naafiri when she is low. She is easier to catch right after she spends Eviscerate.
Use Noxian Diplomacy to jump onto Nidalee. She is weak up close in human form, so burst her before she can switch to cougar form.
Stay out of a straight line with Nidalee. Her Javelin Toss hurts most from far away, and a hit on you makes her faster and her follow-up stronger.
Walk around brush and unclear ground, since Nidalee's invisible Bushwhack traps damage you over time. Vaulting with Assassin's Path over a trap avoids it.
Save Shadow Assault to escape if Nidalee Hunts you. It makes you invisible and fast, and she cannot easily finish you in cougar form.
Use Rake on Nidalee when she steps into cougar form to chase you; it slows her and pushes your Wound stacks toward your passive burst.
Don't spend Rake or Noxian Diplomacy into Nocturne while Shroud of Darkness is up. Wait for it to fade first.
Move away or vault with Assassin's Path when Nocturne starts Unspeakable Horror. Breaking the tether stops the fear.
Stay near your team once Nocturne casts Paranoia. His dash can't be stopped by crowd control, but a spell shield blocks it.
Keep Shadow Assault for escaping Nocturne's dash or his fear. Without it you are easy to catch.
Jump on Nunu with Noxian Diplomacy only when his Snowball Barrage is on cooldown; if you get slowed and rooted you will be caught.
Stay away from Absolute Zero. Use Shadow Assault to get out of the blizzard before it explodes.
Watch for Biggest Snowball Ever! rolling at you, and use Assassin's Path to vault a wall and dodge it.
Gank when Nunu has used his Biggest Snowball Ever!, since he cannot stop you easily afterwards. Use Rake to slow him.
Do not fight Pantheon head-on while Aegis Assault is up. He takes no damage from the front, so wait it out or attack from behind with Assassin's Path.
Keep Shadow Assault ready when you fight Pantheon. His Shield Vault stuns, and the invisibility lets you escape.
Stay away from Pantheon when your health is low; a thrown Comet Spear deals heavy damage to low-health targets.
When Pantheon starts Grand Starfall, you have warning. Move out of the area or get ready to fight him when he lands.
Use Rake and Noxian Diplomacy to build Wound stacks, then attack to cause bleeding. Strike when Pantheon's Aegis Assault is on cooldown.
Cast Shadow Assault to turn invisible when Qiyana tries to lock you down, then walk out or strike back when you reappear.
Open on Qiyana with Rake and Noxian Diplomacy, then hit her with a basic attack to finish the Wound stacks and make her bleed.
Fight Qiyana away from walls and brush. Her Supreme Display of Talent needs terrain to stun, so a fight in open ground is safer for you.
Keep Assassin's Path ready to vault a wall if Qiyana dashes in, so you can get away or reposition behind her.
Don't dive Rammus with Noxian Diplomacy while Frenzying Taunt is ready; being taunted ends your burst.
Skip fighting Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is on; your physical damage does little and every attack hurts you. Hit him when it ends.
Hold Shadow Assault as your escape from Rammus; when it is down, Powerball can catch you.
Use Assassin's Path to roam and pressure other lanes rather than trading with Rammus; target squishier champions instead.
Rek'Sai senses you through Tremor Sense only while you move. Stand still in a bush or use Shadow Assault to slip away.
Stay out of her reach when she is Burrowed; she can knock you up by attacking, which breaks your chain of abilities.
Save Assassin's Path for fleeing over a wall. Rek'Sai can follow through her tunnels, so do not assume a wall is safe.
Hit her with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy, then attack to burst her down. Rek'Sai is slowed and has little reach to answer.
Fight Rengar when his Ferocity is low; his empowered Bola Strike roots, so stay out of its line when he is full.
Keep away from brush when Rengar is near, because his passive lets him leap out of it at you.
Save Shadow Assault to escape a gank; it makes you invisible and fast. Rengar is much harder to run from when it is down.
Hit Rengar with Rake as he leaps in; the returning blades slow him so you can step away.
Fight on your terms: Rake, Noxian Diplomacy, then an attack to finish the Wound bleed before Rengar builds Ferocity.
Keep Shadow Assault ready when you gank or fight near Sejuani; without it you have no easy way out of her stuns.
Walk away from Sejuani when her Permafrost is ready. Fight her only when her stacks are low.
Stay out of a straight line from Sejuani so Glacial Prison and Arctic Assault miss. Hop a wall with Assassin's Path if she gets close.
Aim to kill squishy targets rather than fighting Sejuani. She is a tank, and Noxian Diplomacy gets more from a kill on an easy target.
Slow Sejuani's melee allies with Rake. They need to reach their targets to build stacks for her.
Watch for Shaco's boxes before jumping into a fight. Use Rake to clear a path, and don't run over unseen ground when he is near.
Hold Shadow Assault to escape or to burst Shaco after he spends Deceive. Without it, Talon is exposed.
Shaco is fragile, so jump onto him with Noxian Diplomacy right after he reveals himself, and finish with Blade's End.
Fight Shyvana before she has Dragon Fury for Dragon's Descent; she is far weaker as a human than as a dragon.
Hit her with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy, then a basic attack. Three Wound stacks make Blade's End bleed her.
Use Rake from range and stay out of melee. It leaves her slowed, which cuts down her chasing.
Hold Shadow Assault to escape if she turns into a dragon on you. Her Dragon's Descent flight makes her hard to outrun otherwise.
Vault over a wall with Assassin's Path to escape or to reach her flank when she is farming camps.
Avoid Skarner's Ixtal's Impact when you are near walls. Jump away or use Shadow Assault before he reaches you.
Keep Shadow Assault for escaping Skarner's Impale or for a quick kill. Without it you are an easy target for him.
Hit squishy targets, not Skarner. Use Rake and Noxian Diplomacy on his laners and avoid long fights with him.
Fight Sylas when Hijack is on cooldown, or when your own ultimate is ready, so he cannot turn Shadow Assault against you.
Do not trade into Sylas when he is low on health; Kingslayer heals him back up and can turn the fight.
Hit Sylas with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy, then a basic attack. Three Wound stacks make him bleed hard.
Stay out of line with Abduct. If he stuns you, he follows with a knock up and a burst of damage.
Use Assassin's Path to jump over a wall when you need to dodge his Chain Lash or break away from him.
Do not fight Trundle on his Frozen Domain. Pull the fight away from it or wait until it fades.
Leave Pillar of Ice quickly, or vault out with Assassin's Path. Staying in it keeps you slowed and easy to catch.
Burst Trundle fast with your abilities and Blade's End. A long fight lets him heal and shrug off your damage.
Keep Shadow Assault ready to escape if Trundle lands Subjugate on you.
Chomp lowers your Attack Damage, so avoid trading autos with Trundle right after he hits you with it.
Poke Udyr with Rake from range, since he has few ranged options. Do not stay in melee range of him.
Save Shadow Assault to escape when Udyr's stun lands or he catches you; invisibility and move speed get you out.
Jump away from Udyr with Assassin's Path over a wall when he closes in. Being slowed by his storm makes running away on foot hard.
Wait for Udyr to spend his shield before you burst him with Noxian Diplomacy and your Wound stacks.
Don't brawl with Vi in extended fights; her third hit in a row cuts your Armor and speeds her up. Trade quickly and leave.
Throw Rake as Vi closes in; the returning blades leave her slowed, so Vault Breaker has a harder time catching you.
Use Assassin's Path over a wall when Vi starts charging Vault Breaker. She can only punch in a straight line.
Save Shadow Assault to escape when Vi ults you. Her Cease and Desist cannot be stopped, so don't waste it trying to block the dash.
Land three Wound stacks on Vi, then attack her so Blade's End bleeds her. Kill her quickly before her shield and Attack Speed come online.
Fight Viego before he takes a kill. Once a Mist Wraith appears he can possess a dead champion and heal, so avoid fights where he finishes someone off.
Use Rake and Noxian Diplomacy in the same fight to build Wound stacks, then attack once for the bleed. Do it when Viego has no way to stun you.
Hold Shadow Assault to escape if Viego lands his Spectral Maw. Becoming invisible lets you slip away from him.
Use Assassin's Path to jump over jungle walls and cut off Viego or chase him. Each wall can only be vaulted occasionally, so pick your walls carefully.
Stay out of a long fight with Volibear. He gets tougher and heals as he keeps hitting, so burst him and leave.
Hit Volibear with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy, then an attack. Three Wound stacks make Blade's End bleed him for heavy damage.
Use Rake to keep Volibear slowed when he runs at you; the slow comes from the blades returning.
Jump away with Assassin's Path when Volibear's Thundering Smash is active. It stuns him onto you, so do not let him reach you.
Save Shadow Assault to escape if Volibear lands on you after his leap. It makes you invisible and fast.
Pick a fight when Warwick is above half health; below it, Eternal Hunger heals him with every attack.
Stay healthy; Blood Hunt lets Warwick sense you below half health and run you down fast.
Use Shadow Assault to get away when Warwick locks on, since he follows you through Assassin's Path.
Do not attack right into Primal Howl; wait for it to end, then jump in with Noxian Diplomacy.
Use Rake to slow Warwick as he closes in, so he has a harder time reaching you.
Do not jump onto Xin Zhao when Crescent Guard is ready; it knocks you back and he takes no damage from your allies outside the sweep.
Open on Xin Zhao with Rake from range, then fight when he has to chase you; his Audacious Charge closes gaps fast, so stay near an exit.
Break his combo: when his third strike is coming, move out so Three Talon Strike does not knock you up.
Use Shadow Assault to escape once Xin Zhao has you slowed or pinned; keep it for that rather than starting fights.
Stay out of the goo Zac drops; if an enemy steps on a chunk it is destroyed, so walk over his chunks to deny his healing.
Hit him with Rake before you jump in, so you can start stacking Wound and slow him as you leave.
Keep Shadow Assault ready as your way out; without it Talon has a hard time getting away from Zac's crowd control.
When Zac splits into bloblets, kill them all or he comes back. Use Rake on the bloblets to hit several at once.
Do not stand where Zac can land Stretching Strikes on you and a teammate or minion; he pulls you together and you get stunned.
Use Assassin's Path over a wall to escape or reposition when Zac starts charging Elastic Slingshot.
Save Shadow Assault for when Zed marks you or when you need to leave. Going invisible helps you get away from his burst.
Hit Zed with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy, then a basic attack to finish him with Blade's End. Do it when his Living Shadow is on cooldown.
Use Rake to keep Zed slowed when he tries to run or swap back. His damage depends on staying close.
Use Assassin's Path to get behind Zed and cut off his escape. You can also vault away when he shows up on you.
Jump on Zyra with Noxian Diplomacy when her Grasping Roots is down; she has little to stop you, and she dies fast once you reach her.
Step over her seeds before they turn into plants. If she grows one next to you, back off rather than fight it.
Use Shadow Assault to slip away after Zyra hits you with Stranglethorns or Grasping Roots, or to get past her plants.
Open with Rake, then Noxian Diplomacy and a basic attack, so you reach three Wound stacks and Blade's End bleeds her.
Stay behind minions so Charm cannot reach you; it stops at the first enemy it hits. Ahri's damage drops a lot when she misses it.
Go in once Charm is on cooldown. Leap with Noxian Diplomacy, then use Rake and an attack to finish the fight before it comes back.
Hit Ahri with three abilities and then attack her to make her bleed heavily. Use Noxian Diplomacy and both passes of Rake to build the stacks.
Use Shadow Assault to escape after a trade or to go in. Ahri has trouble hitting you while you are invisible.
Roam with Assassin's Path while Ahri is pushed in. Hop over walls to reach the side lanes before she can follow.
Ahri is weaker when Spirit Rush is down, so pick fights then. Her escape is gone and she cannot easily get away from you.
Aim Rake at Akali at long range, so the returning blades slow her. Then back off before she can trade.
Hit Akali with your spells, then attack her to trigger Blade's End. This is how you burst her down.
Hold Shadow Assault for when Akali goes all in, since it lets you escape her ultimate.
Hit Akali's smoke with spells; area damage reveals her briefly. Then jump on her with Noxian Diplomacy.
Push the wave and use Assassin's Path to roam while Akali is low on Energy. She trades poorly then.
Dodge Flash Frost by staying out of its line, and do not jump in while it is ready; the stun at its end can ruin your fight.
Use Assassin's Path to go around a Crystallize wall instead of walking into it, and attack from the side.
Anivia's egg from Rebirth cannot act, so finish her with burst before she can use it, or wait it out and hit it once she returns.
Do not stand in Glacial Storm for long; it slows you. Roam instead when Anivia is busy pushing the wave.
Go in with Noxian Diplomacy and Rake, then attack to trigger Blade's End. Burst Anivia when she has used Flash Frost.
Use Rake on Aurora to slow her, then jump in with Noxian Diplomacy; both hits count toward Wound.
Stay out of a straight line from Aurora when you can; The Weirding slows you and she hops back out of your reach.
Aurora can slip away with Across the Veil. Save Shadow Assault to chase her down, since the extra move speed catches her.
Do not follow Aurora into the ring from Between Worlds. Enemies who touch its edge are slowed and she can hop across it.
Hit three Wound stacks, then attack her to make her bleed. Burst her down before her recast of Twofold Hex hurts you.
Face away from Cassiopeia or stay out of her cone when she casts Petrifying Gaze. Otherwise you are stunned and killed.
Do not walk into Miasma. It slows you and blocks Assassin's Path while you stand in it.
Dodge Noxious Blast by moving as it lands. It is slow to explode, and each hit makes Twin Fang stronger.
Hold Shadow Assault until her Petrifying Gaze is spent. Then dive her with Noxian Diplomacy and Rake.
Hold Noxian Diplomacy until Fizz has used Playful; while he is untargetable it will not hit him, and it is your main way to close the gap.
Land Rake on Fizz when he walks up to trade; the returning blades leave him slowed and add stacks of Blade's End.
Fizz is hard to burst when his spells are ready. Bait out Playful, then jump in with Noxian Diplomacy and finish with a Blade's End attack.
Keep Shadow Assault ready for the fight. Its invisibility lets you escape when Fizz's Chum the Waters is coming.
Move out of the way of the shark when Chum the Waters hits you, or leave with Assassin's Path over a wall.
Wait until Void Shift has been used up before you jump on Malzahar; while it is active he takes far less damage and ignores your Rake slow.
Stay out of the line between Call of the Void's portals; being silenced in the middle of your combo leaves you helpless.
Do not walk into Malzahar's reach with Shadow Assault down; Nether Grasp suppresses you and lets him finish the job.
Stay away from minions carrying Malefic Visions; when they die it spreads to you.
Use Assassin's Path to roam while Malzahar is pushing, and punish him when he has spent his spells.
Dodge Command: Attack, then jump in with Noxian Diplomacy while the Ball is far from Orianna and the ability is on cooldown.
Do not dive in while Orianna's Command: Shockwave is ready. It stuns you and pulls you into her Ball.
Keep Shadow Assault for escaping after a trade. Its speed and invisibility get you out of her slows.
Hit her with Rake and Noxian Diplomacy to build Wound stacks, then attack to make her bleed.
Stay out of Ryze's range when you can. Once he has Flux on you, his Overload and Rune Prison hit much harder.
Don't jump in with Noxian Diplomacy while Ryze has Rune Prison ready. If you get rooted, you can't escape.
Use Rake to hit Ryze and the minions near him. It slows him on its return, and its hits build Wound stacks on him.
Get to Ryze fast with Noxian Diplomacy, then finish with an attack once you have three Wound stacks on him.
Roam with Assassin's Path when Ryze pushes the wave. Ryze can follow with Realm Warp, but you can still win a side lane first.
Stun or slow Ryze while his Realm Warp is charging, and the portal cancels. Rake's slow can help you do it.
Hit Sylas with Rake and then a basic attack. Two Rake passes and Noxian Diplomacy stack Wound quickly, and the bleed finishes him.
Fight Sylas while he is healthy and has no Kingslayer ready. Its heal is small at high health, so he can't win a long trade.
Don't finish Sylas with a bare minimum of damage left. When he is low, Kingslayer heals him a lot, so burst him down in one go.
Stay out of a straight line to Sylas when Abscond is ready. Abduct stuns you and pulls him onto you.
Use Shadow Assault to leave or to chase once Sylas has used his key spells. Your invisibility makes it hard for him to answer.
Save Assassin's Path for dodging or escaping a Sylas fight. Vaulting a wall can break his Chain Lash and Abduct lines.
Don't jump onto Twisted Fate while he is shuffling for a Gold Card; the stun will cost you your fight.
Stay out of line of Wild Cards when you walk up to the wave. Twisted Fate will poke you down if you let him.
Put Rake on Twisted Fate to slow him, then jump in with Noxian Diplomacy once his card is used up.
When Twisted Fate uses Destiny, expect him to arrive from the side; leave the lane or watch the map before he arrives.
Roam with Assassin's Path while Twisted Fate is pushed up, but know that his Destiny will reveal you.
Dodge Gravity Field's circle or wait it out; if you stay inside, you get slowed and then stunned, and Viktor kills you from there.
Leap in with Noxian Diplomacy when Gravity Field is on cooldown. Viktor has much less to stop you then.
Hit Viktor with Rake and Noxian Diplomacy, then attack him. That builds Wound to the third stack, and his next hit makes him bleed.
Save Shadow Assault for escaping or finishing a kill. Without it, Viktor's Arcane Storm will chase you down.
Step out of Hextech Ray's line early. It is slow, so sidestep it and then close in on Viktor.
Roam over walls with Assassin's Path when you push the wave. Viktor is slow to follow you.
Hold Rake until Yasuo steps up to trade; it hurts on the way out and on the way back, and the return slows him.
Yasuo's Wind Wall blocks your Rake blades, so throw Rake after it fades or from an angle around it.
Land two abilities, then a basic attack, to make Blade's End bleed him. Pick him as your single target and burst him.
Use Noxian Diplomacy from point-blank range so it critically strikes, then follow with Rake.
Keep Shadow Assault ready as your escape. Yasuo's Last Breath needs an airborne target, so be careful around knock-ups from his team.
Trade with Rake when Yone walks up to last-hit; the blades hurt on the way out and again on the way back, and the return slows him.
Fight when Spirit Cleave is on cooldown, since its shield makes your burst weaker.
Hit Yone with your abilities to stack Wound, then finish with a basic attack so he bleeds heavily.
Use Noxian Diplomacy up close for a critical hit, then roam. Yone is slow to follow you out of lane.
Stay away from Yone when Fate Sealed is ready. It can stun you and pull you to him, so keep Shadow Assault ready as your escape.
Hit Zed with Rake when he walks up to trade; the returning blades slow him, so he can't easily chase or flee.
Use Assassin's Path over a wall to flank Zed, then jump in with Noxian Diplomacy in melee range for its stronger hit.
Hold Shadow Assault for when Zed uses Death Mark on you; it lets you turn invisible and run, or fight back.
Land three hits from your abilities, then attack once, so Blade's End bleeds Zed for heavy damage before he can burst you.
Zed's Shadow Slash only slows you if his shadow hits you, so stay out of range of both his shadow and him.
